essence: The practitioner should cause enmity by means of the previous substance
This practice in the Kubjikā doctrine makes the targets mutually hostile
Eradication of the enemy should occur through a mind engaged in meditation
The eradication of the enemy must be conceived in this manner with the intellect
This practice must be carefully concealed and never revealed
